channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemen’s leader announces military operation to retake Houthi-held territory
item.description: Rashad al-Alimi says the campaign aims to restore state authority throughout Yemen.

item.title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge as Germany’s Merz visits Ukraine’s capital
item.description: German chancellor visits Kyiv amid air raid sirens, pledging strong support as Russian strikes disrupt the capital.

item.title: Iran says Hormuz to remain closed until US meets conditions
item.description: Tehran says reopening Strait of Hormuz has been its main goal, while the US continues to focus on nuclear talks.

item.title: Russia’s nuclear plants are ageing. Who will pay to dismantle them?
item.description: Moscow faces a huge decommissioning bill at home even as it expands its nuclear industry abroad.

item.title: Tributes as Bosnian football star Edin Dzeko retires
item.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina's legendary striker Edin Dzeko has bid farewell to international football after a final match.

item.title: Inside the ‘kill box’: The Yemenis who stayed behind in Houthi-held Mocha
item.description: Yemenis trapped in the Red Sea port city speak of deteriorating conditions there.

item.title: Gaza’s Christians mourn mother and daughter killed in Israeli attack
item.description: Maysa Abu Daoud and her daughter Mary al-Najjar among five Palestinians killed in Gaza City attack.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition dismisses ‘misleading’ Houthi claim of Riyadh attack
item.description: The Saudi-led coalition spokesman says the Yemeni armed group is 'attempting to divert attention' from its losses.

item.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
item.description: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

item.title: US father and son arrested after 'gas station heroin' deaths
item.description: They are accused of selling at least one student derivatives of kratom, often called "gas station heroin" in the US.
